value.instructions: Choose exactly one next GUI action to accomplish the task. Use the newest AX tree, SoM observation, task constraints, and execution feedback. For compact typing choices, the current state's focused_input identifies the field; the exact value remains in the Choice criterion. Click a text field to focus it, then select a suitable literal typing action or compose_text to build new input from exact words/characters. Composition inserts at the caret or replaces the current selection, like a normal type action. To replace a nonempty value, select all, then type to replace the selection. Clicking the field repeatedly does not enter text. Use drag/drop choices for Web drag targets. Wait only when timing matters or no offered action advances the task. Earlier marks are stale. Candidate descriptions identify actions, not recommendations. This is one group of a larger candidate set. Select the best action in this group; it will be compared with the other group winners.
